A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delemede/Legends|Delemede]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When a plague broke out on the world, the governor refused a group of Imperial refugees' request for medical aid, but was convinced by Republic diplomats to treat the refugees so that he could claim more Republic resources for his world.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|On Both Their Houses}}</ref>
